name: Olympic Cards Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1992, Olympic Cards Ltd is in the business of providing Wedding Cards and 
Greetings Cards.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
a) OCL is mainly involved in the manufacturing and trading of cards and stationery, along with the trading of items like Screen-Offset Inks, printing inks, etc. Its products include:
a) Wedding Invitation Cards
b) Greeting Cards
c) Visiting Cards
d) Business Cards
e) Office Envelopes
f) Cloth-lined Covers
g) Student Notebooks
h) Account Books
i) Letter Heads
j) Calendars
k) Files, etc.

pros: Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 122 days to 25.2 days
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -21.5% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -77.3% over last 3 years.
